Definition
[Noncharacteristic surface] ↗ def:cauchy-problem-cauchy-data 1. ch4:4.6.1-def-4\group Power Series Methods

An arbitrary smooth hypersurface $\Gamma $ is noncharacteristic if \[ \sum _{|\alpha |=k}a_\alpha u ^\alpha e 0\quad ext{on }\Gamma \] for all coefficient arguments.
